name: extract-done-merge-cleanup-effects
title: Extract DONE merge and worktree cleanup effects
description: Lifecycle Phase 2 step 2 of 3. After Story 3a extracts phase-gates + transition-effects, story_advance.ts still inlines the entire DONE merge / worktree cleanup implementation — the most order-sensitive, highest-risk segment of the handler. The risk is not code complexity but ordering semantics: DONE worktree context detection -> pre-merge stray file check -> metadata commit -> merge story branch to main -> remove worktree -> delete branch -> failure-message shaping. If phase=DONE is written before a merge or pre-cleanup failure is discovered, the story state is corrupted. This story extracts done-effects.ts as a mechanical relocation preserving the exact order and failure semantics, and is deliberately isolated so review focuses entirely on the invariant: phase=DONE is never persisted before merge+cleanup succeed, and merge/cleanup failures are never swallowed. Explicitly out of scope: transition orchestrator coupling (Story 3c), TEST semantics / legacy migration (Story 4).
